name: Animals
blurb: Creatures great and small — a good one for kids.

items.clue: Purrs, ignores you, and owns the internet
Loyal, waggy, and always ready for a walk
Chews the cud and fills the milk jug
Pink, muddy, and mad for truffles
Red, quick, and famously sly
Night hunter with a swivelling head
Sleeps upside down and sees with sound
The tailless cousin on our family tree
Sleeps all winter, then raids the picnic
Wears a mane and answers to king
Howls at the moon and hunts in a pack
Bambi, grown up and antlered
Eats anything, climbs everything
Green, hops, and was once a prince
Walks sideways and argues with claws
Barks, claps, and balances a ball
Near-blind digger who wrecks the lawn
The ugly duckling, all grown up
The warty cousin of the pond hopper
Half horse, half donkey, all stubborn
Burning bright, orange with black bars
Four legs, a mane, and a Derby to win
Counted at bedtime, shorn in spring
Tiny, squeaky, and terrified of the cat
No legs, forked tongue, blamed since Eden
The biggest animal alive, and it sings
Wears its barcode on the savannah
Sleeps twenty hours and eats only eucalyptus
Black-and-white bear with a bamboo habit
Floats on its back and holds hands asleep
Rows of teeth and a very famous fin
Sharp-eyed bird on the American seal
Swings by its tail and steals your banana
Long ears, and late for a very important date
Long-eared worker that says hee-haw
Striped face, digs a sett, out after dark
The fastest diver in the sky
Repeats everything and sits on a pirate
Carries its house and is in no hurry
Whiskers, blubber and two great tusks
Never forgets, and packs its own trunk
The tallest neck on the savannah
Wears a dinner suit and cannot fly
Clicks, leaps, and may be smarter than you
The spotted cat that cannot change them
Silverback ruler of the forest
Stuffs its cheeks and runs a wheel all night
The biggest bird, so it runs instead
